title: Regional air-gapped SAML federation & KMS hardening acceptance playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD addendum and runbook that defines requirements, test scenarios, and an operational acceptance checklist for regional private deployments operating in restricted network (air-gapped) environments. Focus areas: SAML federation configuration and lifecycle in environments where outbound connectivity is restricted, hardened KMS/HSM integration patterns for key import/escrow/rotation, RBAC mapping for operator roles, and audit log extraction/ingestion procedures for compliance evidence. This ticket scopes the signoff bar and provides concrete test cases and mitigations for known failure modes.

acceptance_criteria: SAML federation: IdP metadata can be uploaded via Console and validated with XML schema + certificate chain check in air-gapped deployments
SAML handshake tests: successful end-to-end login using test IdP in isolated lab with simulated clock skew of +/- 5 minutes
RBAC: three operator roles (Operator, Key Custodian, Auditor) available and mapped to SAML attributes; role change events produce audit entries
KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys (CMK) imported and wrapped in supported HSM module; attestation report (vendor-specific) stored in evidence bundle
KMS rotation: documented and tested rotation flow with zero-downtime fallback to previous key and automatic rotation rollback in case of decryption failures
Audit logs: tamper-evident export format generated on-demand and scheduled weekly exports; exports signed and verifiable and retained according to policy

Network constraints: all admin-first flows must work without egress to Redwood hosted endpoints when airgap=true; console provides clear operator errors if an attempted flow requires outbound connectivity
Operational runbook: step-by-step onboarding, emergency key revoke, forensic evidence collection, and escalation contacts documented and validated in tabletop exercise

risks_mitigation: Risk: Dynamic IdP metadata fetch is not possible in air-gapped envs -> Mitigation: require signed metadata uploads and provide a metadata validation tool that runs locally
Risk: Clock skew may break SAML assertions -> Mitigation: provide skew-tolerant validation and explicit test scenario in acceptance harness
Risk: Key compromise during import -> Mitigation: HSM-backed import only, complete escrow workflow, and offline verification step with dual-operator approval
Risk: Audit log tampering -> Mitigation: export signing and retention in append-only storage; include signed manifests in evidence bundle
Risk: Operator error during rotation -> Mitigation: dry-run rotation mode with automatic rollback and alerting to Key Custodian role
decision_log: 2026-03-06: Decided NOT to support automatic metadata refresh for first air-gapped release due to inability to reach IdP endpoints; UX compromise accepted to meet security constraints
2026-03-09: Chose signed export format (JSONL + detached signature) for audit evidence to simplify verification across customer environments
2026-03-11: Selected three operator roles model for RBAC to match common enterprise compliance templates (Operator, Key Custodian, Auditor)
